description:
*Note: This is a promotional oneshot.*  
[Promotional Webtoon](https://page.kakao.com/home/50631006)

"Stamp these divorce papers, please."

After five years of marriage, my husband ended it with one envelope.

I can't believe I was chased out by his nine-tailed fox-like lover. 

"How dare you! You can't do this to me!"

In a burst of anger, I opened my eyes and returned to the time before Ophelia's engagement, the spring when I was 18 years old. 

My God-given second chance. I'll make a different choice this time. A dress instead of a knight's uniform, jewellery instead of swords!

Eckhardt Beyard, this time it's my turn. Take a taste of your own medicine for once. 

A courageous female knight is born again as a beautiful lady!

Original Novel:       
         [Kakao Page](https://page.kakao.com/content/50631006?tab_type=preview), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/777048070)
